input.objective: Token name: INK. Token symbol: INK. Launch it with the InkHook from this repository on its pool, paired with ETH (Sepolia rehearsal; mainnet pairs with IMD), on Sepolia. Keep the hook's logic as written. Constructor values: portraits = REPLACE_WITH_INKPORTRAITS_ADDRESS, vault = REPLACE_WITH_VAULT_ADDRESS, imd = native ETH (address 0), treasury = REPLACE_WITH_OWNER_ADDRESS, feeBps = 25 (a 0.25% hook fee on top of the pool's own fee, waived for wallets holding an agent portrait; ETH fees go to the treasury and INK fees are sent to 0x000000000000000000000000000000000000dEaD; do not sell hook fees for ETH). Trading lock: the hook rejects every swap until vault.released() is true; there is no time-based fallback (anyone can call release() once the vault's 24-hour claim window ends, and it adds the unclaimed INK to the pool in the same transaction). The agent-holder fee waiver requires portraits.isAgentHolder(tx.origin), which needs the portrait held since an earlier block. Nobody can change any of these after deployment: the hook has no owner, admin or upgrade role, and none may be added. The pool trading fee share goes to the paying wallet, which is REPLACE_WITH_OWNER_ADDRESS.
